FaceCut01: Welcome adventurers that wish to try their hand at glory in the Arena!
FaceCut02: You and your team members have to protect your own flag while trying to steal the opponent's flag.
FaceCut03: The player who is carrying the enemy flag is called a runner. If the runner can bring the opponent's flag back to their own team's flag, they will score points.
FaceCut04: Whichever team has the most points when the game timer reaches zero is the winner.
